name: Configure Email Notifications
description: Set up email alerts for important system events

steps.title: Open Notification Settings
steps.description: Navigate to Settings and select the Notifications tab.

steps.title: Enable Email Notifications
steps.description: Toggle the email notifications switch to ON.

steps.title: Select Event Types
steps.description: Choose which events should trigger email notifications.

steps.title: Set Email Recipients
steps.description: Add email addresses that should receive notifications.

steps.title: Test Notification
steps.description: Send a test email to verify the configuration is working.

steps.title: Save Configuration
steps.description: Click Save to apply your notification settings.
